title: Dima and Salad
statementMd:
Dima, Inna and Seryozha have gathered in a room. That's right, someone's got to go. To cheer Seryozha up and inspire him to have a walk, Inna decided to cook something.

Dima and Seryozha have $*n*$ fruits in the fridge. Each fruit has two parameters: the taste and the number of calories. Inna decided to make a fruit salad, so she wants to take some fruits from the fridge for it. Inna follows a certain principle as she chooses the fruits: the total taste to the total calories ratio of the chosen fruits must equal $*k*$. In other words, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9f1953e21ee6c2ae7c89436adda5918282356d42.png) , where $*a*_{*j*}$ is the taste of the $*j*$-th chosen fruit and $*b*_{*j*}$ is its calories.

Inna hasn't chosen the fruits yet, she is thinking: what is the maximum taste of the chosen fruits if she strictly follows her principle? Help Inna solve this culinary problem — now the happiness of a young couple is in your hands!

Inna loves Dima very much so she wants to make the salad from at least one fruit.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$, $*k*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100, 1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10)$. The second line of the input contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100)$ — the fruits' tastes. The third line of the input contains $*n*$ integers $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 100)$ — the fruits' calories. Fruit number $*i*$ has taste $*a*_{*i*}$ and calories $*b*_{*i*}$.

## Output

If there is no way Inna can choose the fruits for the salad, print in the single line number -1. Otherwise, print a single integer — the maximum possible sum of the taste values of the chosen fruits.

## Note

In the first test sample we can get the total taste of the fruits equal to 18 if we choose fruit number 1 and fruit number 2, then the total calories will equal 9. The condition ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f7429bb0084a26268b364ce919a5231a4d9e38a9.png) fulfills, that's exactly what Inna wants.

In the second test sample we cannot choose the fruits so as to follow Inna's principle.
statementZhMd:
Dima、Inna 和 Seryozha 聚集在一个房间里。没错，总得有人离开。为了让 Seryozha 开心起来，并鼓励他出去散步，Inna 决定做点什么。

Dima 和 Seryozha 的冰箱里有 $*n*$ 个水果。每个水果有两个参数：味道和卡路里。Inna 决定制作水果沙拉，因此她想从冰箱中取出一些水果。Inna 按照某种原则选择水果：所选水果的总味道与总卡路里的比值必须等于 $*k*$。换句话说，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9f1953e21ee6c2ae7c89436adda5918282356d42.png)，其中 $*a*_{*j}$ 是第 $*j*$ 个所选水果的味道，$*b*_{*j}$ 是第 $*j*$ 个所选水果的卡路里。

Inna 还没有选择水果，她正在思考：如果严格遵循她的原则，所选水果的总味道最大是多少？请帮助 Inna 解决这个烹饪问题——现在，一对年轻情侣的幸福掌握在你的手中！

Inna 非常爱 Dima，因此她希望沙拉至少由一个水果制成。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$、$*k*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100, 1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10)$。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100)$，表示水果的味道。第三行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n}$ $(1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 100)$，表示水果的卡路里。编号为 $*i*$ 的水果的味道为 $*a*_{*i*}$，卡路里为 $*b*_{*i*}$。

## 输出格式

如果 Inna 无法选择满足条件的水果制作沙拉，在单独一行中输出数字 -1。否则，输出一个整数，即所选水果的味道总和的最大值。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，如果选择编号 1 和编号 2 的水果，可以得到味道总和 18，此时卡路里总和为 9。条件![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f7429bb0084a26268b364ce919a5231a4d9e38a9.png)得到满足，这正是 Inna 想要的结果。

在第二个样例中，无法选择一些水果使其满足 Inna 的原则。
